title: Focused implementation review
statement: As a reviewer, I can open focused visual decks from a Report Saga and inspect the exact code behind each explanation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A report can expose several optional decks without rendering user stories or ordinary report fragments as slides.
Only semantic Items own exact diff evidence, including contextual surprise callouts.
The reviewer exposes a separate Decks surface with slide navigation, Item links, comments, and per-slide decisions.
